title: Re: Quick demo — async option + micro-slot alternatives
text:
Re: Quick demo — async option + micro-slot alternatives

["From: Alex Rivera <alex@lumobar.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-11-19T20:02:00Z
Subject: Quick demo — had a conflict, can we reschedule?

Hi Grace,

Sorry I missed our slot today — an internal review ran long and I couldn't break away. We just spun up a trial org (LMO-2934) and I'd still like to see how Redwood fits into our inference pipeline, but my calendar this week is noisy.

Is there a way to get a short async walkthrough (recording + short Q/A) or a very compact live slot (10–15 min)? If there are any pre-recorded highlights you recommend, please send. Also, my security lead sometimes needs to see the SOC2 evidence — is that something you can surface?

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
Director of Data Platforms
Lumobar Analytics

", "From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@lumobar.com>
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-11-19T22:46:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick demo — async option + micro-slot alternatives

Hi Alex — no worries, these things happen. Thanks for the trial org id (LMO-2934) — that's helpful. Two quick paths that have worked well for other engineering teams in your situation: 

- 15-min micro-slot: a focused, live walkthrough of the live UI + one tailored question. Good when you want product clarity fast.
- Async package: a 7–10 minute annotated recording that walks your trial org + a 10-min live office-hours slot for follow-up (we can record the office hours as well).

Proposed micro-slot times (PST):
- Tue Nov 21, 10:00–10:15 AM PST
- Wed Nov 22, 11:00–11:15 AM PST

If async sounds better I can send the recording and a 10-min office-hours link. I attached a short demo-prep checklist that will speed things up.

Quick note on SOC2: I can share our compliance pack — if your security lead wants the evidence, I can CC them and include the SOC2 snapshot in the handoff.

If one of those times works, hit the one-click link to add it to your calendar: https://cal.redwood.ai/s/15min/grace-quickslot

Best,
Grace O'Connor
SDR, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Attachments: demo-prep-checklist.pdf (PDF, 1 page)

", "From: Alex Rivera <alex@lumobar.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-11-19T23:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick demo — async option + micro-slot alternatives

Grace — thanks, the async package looks like the right fit for our org this week. If you can send the recording and a short office-hours slot we can put together a short list of stakeholders for the Q/A.

Also, can you include a one-pager for the SOC2 snapshot so I can pass it to our security lead? If it's easier, CC them on the next message — their email is rachel@lumobar.com.

Appreciate it,
Alex

", "From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@lumobar.com>, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-11-20T08:05:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Quick demo — async option + micro-slot alternatives 

Looping in Priyom (AE) to run the async package and own the short office-hours Q/A. Priyom — Alex is on a trial org (LMO-2934) and prefers an async recording + 10-minute live slot. Alex asked for SOC2 details for their security lead (rachel@lumobar.com).

I've attached a mutual action plan draft that captures the suggested cadence (recording now, office-hours next week) and a checklist we shared earlier. Proposed next steps: 

1) Priyom records a 7–10 minute annotated walkthrough of LMO-2934 focused on latency/cost controls and routing policies.
2) Share SOC2 snapshot one-pager for Rachel.
3) Offer a 10-min office-hours slot (Priyom) — I recommend Wed Nov 22, 11:00–11:10 AM PST so it's compact and easy to accept.

Alex — if that date/time works, Priyom will send the calendar invite (one-click). Priyom / Tessa, attaching the mutual_action_plan_v1.pdf and the trial link below.

Trial org: https://app.redwood.ai/orgs/LMO-2934
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/89012

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_v1.pdf

Best,
Grace O'Connor
SDR, Redwood Inference
", "From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@lumobar.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-11-20T09:17:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick demo — async option + micro-slot alternatives

Thanks Grace — happy to take this over. Alex, I'll put together the annotated recording this morning and send the SOC2 one-pager for Rachel. I've penciled in Wed Nov 22, 11:00–11:10 AM PST for a quick office-hours session and will drop a calendar invite (with a short agenda) in the next 30 minutes:

Agenda (10 min):
- 3 min: walkthrough highlights (latency, batching, smart routing)
- 4 min: live Q/A on trial org items you flagged
- 3 min: next steps / mutual action items

If anyone else at Lumobar wants to join, feel free to forward the invite. I'll share the recording link + SOC2 packet in the invite thread.

Speak soon —
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai
